2608.22917.title: TSWAP: A Multilingual Retrieval-Augmented Thai Wellness Advisor
2608.22917.paper_summary: We present TSWAP, a deployed eight-language conversational wellness advisor grounded, via retrieval-augmented generation, in a verified knowledge base of Thai traditional medicine and certified wellness providers. An unmodified open-weight LLM (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on vLLM) is grounded on a ~30.6K-chunk Thai index by a hybrid dense-sparse retriever with cross-encoder reranking; a first-turn query classifier forces tool-based retrieval for entity lookups; a rule-based safety layer enforces medical scope and Thai emergency routing; and all eight languages are served zero-shot with translate-then-retrieve. We release the first Thai traditional-medicine/wellness retrieval benchmark (50 questions with gold document IDs; Recall@5 = 0.88), production QA logs (91.1% test-retest pass over 259 cases), and a 71-question frontier no-retrieval probe showing what each grounding pillar contributes: without the safety prompt the backend model family produced a full drug-dosing schedule and complied with out-of-scope requests, and without the knowledge base it produced zero verifiable provider recommendations. We further report two transferable deployment findings: English-calibrated 4-bit AWQ quantization corrupts Thai tone marks, and forced-retrieval routing is necessary for reliable grounding.
2608.22917.paper_summary_zh: 我們提出了TSWAP，一個已部署的八語言對話健康顧問，通過檢索增強生成，基於一個經過驗證的泰國傳統醫學知識庫和認證的健康提供者。未經修改的開放權重LLM（Qwen3.6-35B-A3B在vLLM上）基於一個約30.6K塊的泰國索引，通過混合密集-稀疏檢索器和交叉編碼重排序進行基礎設置；第一輪查詢分類器強制基於工具的檢索以進行實體查詢；基於規則的安全層強制執行醫療範疇和泰國緊急路由；所有八種語言均以零-shot方式提供，使用翻譯然後檢索。我們發布了首個泰國傳統醫學/健康檢索基準（50個問題及金標文件ID；Recall@5 = 0.88）、生產QA日誌（在259個案例中91.1%的測試-重測通過率），以及一個71個問題的前沿無檢索探測，顯示每個基礎支柱的貢獻：在沒有安全提示的情況下，後端模型家族生成了完整的藥物劑量計劃並遵從了超出範疇的請求，而在沒有知識庫的情況下，它生成了零個可驗證的提供者推薦。我們進一步報告了兩個可轉移的部署發現：經過英語校準的4位AWQ量化會損壞泰語音調標記，並且強制檢索路由對於可靠的基礎設置是必要的。
